examples.en: Do you sleep at night? I do not sleep. I am awake by night and by day. Did you not grow tired? A machine does not grow tired.

examples.en: The liquid is deep.

examples.pie: pótni kéh₂ileh₂ h₁sdʰí. snígʷʰs dʰubʰréh₂ góloh₂-kʷe. gʰóstey dṓm wiḱdʰí. priHós nos h₁sdʰí. ph₂wéni gʷʰr̥dʰí. pótni te gʷr̥néHoh₂.
examples.en: Be well, mistress! The snow is deep, and I am freezing. Enter the house, guest! Be dear to us. Get warm at the fire. I will praise you, mistress.

examples.pie: gʷíh₃woyh₁me sóh₂wl̥-kʷe dr̥ḱih₁mé.
examples.en: May we live and see the Sun.

examples.pie: h₂woldʰéyoyh₁t h₃rḗǵs h₁léwdʰim h₁léwdʰis-kʷe gʷíh₃woyh₁t.
examples.en: May the king rule the people, and may the people live.

examples.pie: só gʷíh₃weti h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe gʷéyh₃mi túH-kʷe gʷíh₃wesi.
examples.en: He lives, and I live, and you live.

examples.pie: h₁ésh₂r̥ toy h₁sh₂énh₁ h₁léwdʰetu.
examples.en: Let your blood grow with blood.

examples.pie: moysóm gʷoh₂móm wédʰe. h₁ím ḱéstroh₁ skl̥Hdʰí. h₁ésyo h₁ésh₂r̥ dʰǵʰémi sikʷdʰí. mḗms gʷrúsu pékʷe. dʰh₁séy pr̥h₂wóm bʰoh₂góm dh₃dʰí sélpos-kʷe ph₂wéni h₁éwse. nu h₁léwdʰeyes mḗms h₁édonti.
examples.en: Lead the ram to the altar. Slit it open with the knife. Pour out its blood on the earth. Cook the meat on spits. Give the first share to the god, and burn the fat in the fire. Then let the people eat the meat.

examples.pie: kr̥snéh₂i me nékʷti kélh₂s. h₁ésh₂r̥-ge moy te sékʷoyh₁to. suHnéwes moy te wrégoyh₁ent. ḱéstrom-ge toy téwe ǵʰóstoy Hrumpih₁tó. h₁wésu-ge toy ḱléwos n̥ḱyéh₁t. h₁nómn̥ toy mórtoysu n̥ḱyéh₁t.
examples.en: You struck me in the black night. May my blood follow you. May my sons hunt you. May your knife break in your hand. May your good fame perish. May your name be lost among mortals.

examples.pie: príHe wĺ̥kʷom gʷʰéns? h₁ím ǵʰoysóh₁ gʷʰénm̥. túH dʰr̥sús. trésom. nu h₂egʷnṓs kéh₂ilōs. dyḗws te ph₂tḗr ph₂syéh₁t.
examples.en: Friend, did you kill the wolf? I killed him with a spear. You are brave! I was trembling. Now the lambs are unharmed. May Father Sky guard you!

examples.pie: wr̥h₁dʰí moy kʷíd h₁éḱwos h₂élgʷʰeti? h₁wésus h₁éḱwos déḱm̥ ugʷsénn̥s h₂élgʷʰeti. kʷíd pṓlHos h₂élgʷʰeti? pṓlHos pénkʷe h₂egʷnóns h₂élgʷʰeti.
examples.en: Tell me, what is a horse worth? A good horse is worth ten oxen. What is a foal worth? A foal is worth five lambs.

examples.pie: wĺ̥kʷos h₂egʷnóm sruméni widét h₂éǵt. méne wódr̥ péh₃s. h₂egʷnós wérh₁t. wĺ̥kʷe téwe wódr̥ ne péh₃m̥. nu lémbʰt wĺ̥kʷos h₂egʷnóm h₁ím-kʷe h₂éḱh₃t.
examples.en: A wolf saw a lamb at the stream. He said: "You drank my water!" The lamb said: "Wolf, I did not drink your water." Then the wolf seized the lamb and ate it up.

examples.pie: h₂énteros h₂éǵros tósmōd h₂éǵrōd méǵh₂yōs h₁ést h₂érh₃yome-kʷe tóm.
examples.en: The other field was bigger than this field, and we ploughed it.

examples.pie: kʷís h₂érh₃yeti h₂nḗr-kʷe ne h₁ésti? só yugtós h₁éḱwos h₁ésti.
examples.en: Who ploughs and is not a man? It is the yoked stallion.

examples.pie: kʷís h₂érh₃yet? túH h₂érh₃yes h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe sh₁ésdʰom.
examples.en: Who ploughed? You ploughed, and I harvested.

examples.pie: h₂éwsōs h₂wést. bʰéwdʰesi? nu bʰéwdʰoh₂. h₁eǵʰ gʷm̥dʰí sóh₂wl̥-kʷe widé.

examples.pie: h₂éwsos diwés dʰúgh₂ter h₂usdʰí. h₁érkʷomes te.

examples.pie: nu nos h₂éwsōs h₂usyéh₁t widóyh₁me-kʷe tā́m.
examples.en: Now may the dawn become bright for us, and may we see her!

examples.en: Who saw the ram from the sky and was gripping it? It was the eagle.

examples.en: Who creeps in the field? He seizes a bird, but he does not grasp with a hand. Guess! It is a snake.

root.gloss: to be lying down; to settle
